newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-SURREY BEAT KENT TO WIN BENSON AND HEDGES CUP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SURREY BEAT KENT TO WIN BENSON AND HEDGES CUP.

text.p: Surrey achieved one of the most comprehensive victories in the history of Benson and Hedges Cup finals when they beat Kent by eight wickets at Lord's on Saturday.
Needing 213 in 50 overs, the favourites cruised home with five overs to spare.
Ben Hollioake, who made 98 off 112 balls, won the man of the match after setting up victory with his second-wicket stand of 159 with Alec Stewart (75 not out).
It was the first time Surrey had won the trophy since 1974 and Kent's fourth defeat in four finals since 1986.
